text:
Claire - BlueHarbor: Hey team — our renewal is scheduled next Tue. Procurement says they need the invoice under a different legal entity (BlueHarbor EU Ltd.) and they also require SSO configuration confirmed before signing. Is that a blocker for execution?
Ayesha (CSM): Thanks Claire — noted. Quick checklist: new billing entity, PO vs CC, MSA redline for entity change, and SSO/SP metadata. Marcus can you advise on invoicing flow for EU entity?
Marcus (Finance): We can invoice the EU entity but need VAT number + legal entity registration. If procurement insists on PO + net45 that's fine; we'll accept PO then route to AR. If Claire can share VAT now we can draft invoice.
Claire - BlueHarbor: VAT: GB123456789. Procurement insists on vendor code too — they said "no card payments" for renewals. CFO prefers card but procurement is the gate.
Olivia (Legal): I can produce a redline of the MSA to swap the entity name, should be quick. Question: do we need countersign or just e-sign? If it's a new billing entity we'll likely need a countersign on a short addendum. Estimated 2 business days for a clean redline once I have the exact entity name and signing party.
Ben (Solutions Eng): For SSO I need the SP metadata. Typical values we need: ACS URL, EntityID, and an x.509 cert thumbprint. Example ACS we usually use: `https://sso.redwood.example/acs/<customer>` — Claire can you confirm ACS and if they use Okta or Azure AD?
Claire - BlueHarbor: They use Azure AD. ACS will be `https://sso.blueharbor.eu/auth/saml/acs`. Entity ID: `https://blueharbor.eu/saml`. I'll DM the cert.
docsend-bot: uploaded updated_msa_blueharbor_eu_v1.pdf — https://docsend.example/abcd1234
Ayesha (CSM): Good. Two follow-ups: 1) Marcus — can we do a short-term extension if entity swap delays the invoice? 2) Ben — can we do a staged SSO cutover (workaround: email login until SSO complete) so enablement isn't blocked?
Marcus (Finance): We can offer a 30-day term extension and prorated invoice for the delta. We'll need PO number to reserve the renewal price. If PO arrives after the renewal date we can still honor price if received within 7 days of renewal.
Ben (Solutions Eng): Yes we can do staged cutover. We can provision accounts and run enablement with email auth, then flip SAML once metadata is live. Need a date for the flip — add me to the ticket.
Olivia (Legal): I'm drafting the addendum now. Claire — confirm the signatory name exactly (full legal name + title) and whether local counsel is required.
Claire - BlueHarbor: Signatory: "BlueHarbor EU Ltd., by: Marta Jensen, CFO" — Marta is fine to sign. No local counsel. PO number TBD by procurement, they said will issue by EOD Fri.
Ayesha (CSM): I'll update the renewal quote to a new quote id `Q-48291-EU` with 12-month term, same per-seat price, and a note for prorate + 30-day grace. Claire — can you confirm seat count for renewal?
Claire - BlueHarbor: We're renewing 85 seats but moving 5 to a different org after renewal (so net 80 on day 31).
Marcus (Finance): Noted — we'll apply prorate on seats moving off after the first month. Please confirm effective date so I can prepare the invoice entity fields.
Ayesha (CSM): Tentative plan: renew on 2026-04-01 under BlueHarbor EU Ltd., invoice net45 to the PO. If PO not in by 2026-04-08 we hold the price for 7 days per Marcus. Olivia will send addendum for Marta to sign; Ben will schedule enablement for week of 2026-04-05 and do SSO flip after metadata is live.
Claire - BlueHarbor: Sounds good. I'll chase procurement for PO and push Marta for signature once addendum arrives. Thanks all. :pray:
Ben (Solutions Eng): I'll open a ticket for SSO config and drop the SP metadata template now.
Olivia (Legal): Addendum uploaded to DocSend link (docsend-bot) — I redlined the entity section, waiting on Claire to confirm minor wording.
Ayesha (CSM): Great — I'll follow up with a single summary email to Claire and copy procurement, finance, and legal. If anything slips, we have the 30-day extension as a fallback. :thumbsup:
